test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: India's highway network is one of the largest in the world. Which scheme focuses on the development of highways, particularly in economic corridors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatmala Pariyojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatmala Pariyojana** is a flagship program launched by the Government of India to enhance and expand the highway network across the country.
 
• It focuses on the development of **economic corridors, inter-corridors, feeder routes, and border roads** to improve connectivity and facilitate trade and commerce.
 
• The program aims to **reduce travel time**, improve efficiency in freight transportation, and decrease logistics costs, which are vital for economic growth.
 
• Under this scheme, the government plans to construct approximately **34,800 km of roads** in the first phase, with a focus on key corridors and areas of strategic importance.
 
• The initiative also integrates connectivity for **ports, industrial clusters, and backward areas**, ensuring a holistic development approach. *Hence, this scheme is specifically designed for the development of highways.*
 
• The Bharatmala Pariyojana complements other infrastructure projects like the **Sagarmala Project**, which focuses on port-led development, ensuring integrated transportation solutions. *Hence, the correct answer is Bharatmala Pariyojana.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):**

 
 
• Launched in **2000**, PMGSY focuses on **rural road connectivity** rather than highways. It aims to connect unconnected villages with all-weather roads.
 
• The scheme is particularly important for agricultural and rural development, as it facilitates better access to markets, schools, and healthcare services.
 
 
 
• **BharatNet:**
 
 
• BharatNet aims to provide **broadband connectivity** to gram panchayats across India, with the primary focus on digital inclusion rather than physical infrastructure.
 
• It is designed to support e-governance initiatives, online education, telemedicine, and other digital services in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Sagarmala:**
 
 
• Sagarmala focuses on **port-led development** by enhancing coastal connectivity, modernizing ports, and promoting industrial clusters near ports.
 
• It aims to improve logistics efficiency and reduce transportation costs for goods, especially those related to maritime trade.
 
 
 
• **Bharatmala Pariyojana:**
 
 
• Launched in **2017**, it is India’s largest and most ambitious highway development program.
 
• It focuses on economic corridors, national corridors, and expressways to ensure seamless connectivity across the country.
 
• The program also integrates rural and urban areas, contributing to regional development and boosting the economy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Corridors:**

 
 
• Economic corridors are designed to connect major industrial hubs and commercial centers, ensuring efficient transportation of goods.
 
• These corridors aim to reduce travel time and improve the logistical efficiency of freight movement.
 
 
 
• **Inter-corridors and feeder routes:**
 
 
• Inter-corridors and feeder routes improve connectivity between economic corridors and rural areas, ensuring last-mile connectivity.
 
• They play a crucial role in integrating backward areas with industrial hubs, contributing to regional development.
 
 
 
• **Border Roads:**
 
 
• Border roads under Bharatmala Pariyojana enhance strategic connectivity to remote border areas, ensuring better access and security.
 
• These roads also support military logistics and improve infrastructure in sensitive regions.
